text: Pre-Existing Disease means any condition, ailment or injury diagnosed by a physician, or for which medical advice or treatment was received, within 48 months prior to the first policy issued by the insurer.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 1 - Key Definitions > 1.1 Pre-Existing Disease]
Pre-Existing Disease means any condition, ailment or injury diagnosed by a physician, or for which medical advice or treatment was received, within 48 months prior to the first policy issued by the insurer.

text: Network Provider means hospitals enlisted by the insurer to provide medical services to an insured person on payment by a cashless facility.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 1 - Key Definitions > 1.2 Network Provider]
Network Provider means hospitals enlisted by the insurer to provide medical services to an insured person on payment by a cashless facility.

text: We will pay for medical expenses for hospitalisation of the insured person for a minimum period of 24 hours, including room charges, ICU charges, doctor fees, medicines and diagnostic tests.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 2 - What Is Covered > 2.1 Hospitalisation Expenses]
We will pay for medical expenses for hospitalisation of the insured person for a minimum period of 24 hours, including room charges, ICU charges, doctor fees, medicines and diagnostic tests.

text: Room rent is covered up to a Single Private Room. There is no capping on room rent in rupee terms. If a room category higher than Single Private Room is chosen, a proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 2 - What Is Covered > 2.2 Room Category]
Room rent is covered up to a Single Private Room. There is no capping on room rent in rupee terms. If a room category higher than Single Private Room is chosen, a proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses.

text: Road ambulance expenses are covered up to Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation for transfer to the nearest hospital in an emergency.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 2 - What Is Covered > 2.3 Ambulance Cover]
Road ambulance expenses are covered up to Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation for transfer to the nearest hospital in an emergency.

text: A co-payment of 10% applies on all claims, irrespective of the age of the insured person.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 2 - What Is Covered > 2.4 Co-payment]
A co-payment of 10% applies on all claims, irrespective of the age of the insured person.

text: If the Sum Insured is exhausted during the policy year, it will be restored once by 100% for subsequent unrelated illnesses in the same policy year.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 2 - What Is Covered > 2.5 Restoration of Sum Insured]
If the Sum Insured is exhausted during the policy year, it will be restored once by 100% for subsequent unrelated illnesses in the same policy year.

text: Any illness contracted within 30 days of the policy start date is not covered, except accidental injuries.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 3 - Waiting Periods > 3.1 First 30 Days]
Any illness contracted within 30 days of the policy start date is not covered, except accidental injuries.

text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 48 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 3 - Waiting Periods > 3.2 Pre-Existing Diseases]
Pre-existing diseases are covered after 48 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date.

text: Treatment of cataract, hernia, kidney stones and gall bladder stones is covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. Joint replacement surgery including knee replacement is covered after 36 months of continuous coverage unless required due to an accident.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 3 - Waiting Periods > 3.3 Specified Illnesses and Surgeries]
Treatment of cataract, hernia, kidney stones and gall bladder stones is covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. Joint replacement surgery including knee replacement is covered after 36 months of continuous coverage unless required due to an accident.

text: Maternity expenses are not covered under this policy.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 3 - Waiting Periods > 3.4 Maternity]
Maternity expenses are not covered under this policy.

text: Cosmetic or aesthetic treatment of any description is excluded, unless required due to accident, burns or cancer.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 4 - Exclusions > 4.1 Cosmetic Treatment]
Cosmetic or aesthetic treatment of any description is excluded, unless required due to accident, burns or cancer.

text: Expenses arising from participation in hazardous or adventure sports such as para-jumping, rock climbing, mountaineering and scuba diving are excluded.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 4 - Exclusions > 4.2 Hazardous Sports]
Expenses arising from participation in hazardous or adventure sports such as para-jumping, rock climbing, mountaineering and scuba diving are excluded.

text: Cost of spectacles, contact lenses and hearing aids is excluded.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Care Plus | Part 4 - Exclusions > 4.3 Spectacles and Contact Lenses]
Cost of spectacles, contact lenses and hearing aids is excluded.
